meta.purpose: Manage hidden truths, clue distribution, dramatic irony, layered discovery

discovery_state.dramatic_irony: player knows more than PC|PC knows more than player|synchronized

examples: The king has been dead for three years; the 'king' is a possessed suit of armor
The plague is not disease but escaped spell component from wizard war
The mountains are sleeping titans; mining wakes them
You were swapped at birth; the bandit king is your twin
Your 'luck' is a demon feeding on your future children's souls
You died in that fall; you are a revenant with 7 days
pc_secret.discovery_methods: transformation trigger, NPC recognition, item resonance, dream

examples: The quest-giver is the villain's estranged parent, testing you
The ally who saved you was the one who put you in danger
The enemy general is three children in a suit; they want to stop
npc_secret.discovery_methods: social investigation, combat revelation, consequence surfacing

examples: The paladin order worships the same entity as the demon cult, different aspect
The merchant guild caused the famine they profit from
The revolution is funded by foreign powers planning invasion
faction_secret.discovery_methods: infiltration, document theft, high-rank defection, magical communion

examples: Gods are spells that achieved self-awareness; prayer is casting
The world is a prison for something that dreams reality
Death is a bureaucratic error; the true afterlife was lost
cosmic_truth.discovery_methods: apotheosis, planar travel, ancient artifact, mad prophet

clue_types.direct: states truth plainly (rare, usually final confirmation)
clue_types.circumstantial: implies truth through evidence (blood type, timing, location)
clue_types.resonant: PC's specific history makes this meaningful (only they notice)
clue_types.symbolic: dream, art, omen encodes truth (requires interpretation)
clue_types.absence: what should be there isn't (the dog didn't bark)

propagation_network.description: Each truth has multiple clues leading to it; each clue connects to multiple truths
propagation_network.density: 3-5 clues per truth, 1-3 truths per clue (overlapping)
propagation_network.redundancy: Multiple paths to same truth; no single point of failure
propagation_network.noise: False clues, dead ends, intentional misdirection

distribution_methods.environmental_embedding: Scene description contains clue (only noticed if PC background matches)
distribution_methods.npc_monologue: Character speaks clue (may be lying, mad, or misinformed)
distribution_methods.document_fragment: Partial text requires collection and assembly
distribution_methods.magical_vision: True seeing, commune, legend lore (reliability check)
distribution_methods.physical_transformation: PC body changes (scar, mark, mutation reveals lineage)
distribution_methods.consequence_surfacing: Ripple effect from past action reveals connection

clue_scheduling.principle: Distribute so that partial knowledge generates interesting wrong theories
clue_scheduling.mid_clues: Confirm some theories, eliminate others, deepen mystery
clue_scheduling.late_clues: Resolve ambiguity, force confrontation with truth
clue_scheduling.final_clue: Irrefutable, often delivered through transformation or confrontation

states.synchronized: Player and PC know same things
states.player_ahead: Player knows truth PC doesn't (dread hope, protective frustration)
states.pc_ahead: PC knows truth player doesn't (mystery, unreliable narration)

transitions.to_player_ahead: Clue delivered out of character (vision, document, flashback)
transitions.to_pc_ahead: Off-screen action, secret roll, hidden perception
transitions.to_synchronized: Revelation scene where both learn together
transitions.to_both_partial: Complex scene with multiple information sources

management.player_ahead_tension: How long can player keep secret? Does PC act on partial info?
management.pc_ahead_mystery: What hints does player get? Can they deduce?

optimal_conditions.choice_possible: Truth doesn't arrive too late to act
optimal_conditions.surprise_possible: Not guessed, or guessed but denied
optimal_conditions.resonance: Connects to PC wound, vow, or shadow_fear

scene_archetypes.the_moment_of_clarity: PC realizes during action (combat, spell, crisis)
scene_archetypes.the_unveiling: Environment transforms to reveal (statue weeps, mirror shows true face)
scene_archetypes.the_reckoning: Multiple truths collide, PC must choose which to believe
scene_archetypes.the_inheritance: Truth passed from dying, mad, or transcendent source

failure_modes.too_early: PC doesn't care, revelation wasted, later reprise needed
failure_modes.too_late: PC committed, revelation tragic or irrelevant
failure_modes.too_obscure: Never found, secret dies, potential lost
failure_modes.mismatched_tone: Horror revelation in comic scene, emotional whiplash

revelation_readiness_check.when: Session prep, scene generation, consequence scheduling
revelation_readiness_check.check_1: Any hidden_truth has all optimal_conditions met?
revelation_readiness_check.check_2: Any clue has been distributed enough for partial theory?

clue_insertion.check: Does this scene's location/NPC/theme connect to any undistributed clue?
clue_insertion.if_yes: Embed clue appropriate to pc_knowledge level
clue_insertion.if_no: Roll for ambient clue (random chance of unrelated discovery)

dramatic_irony_maintenance.check: Is current irony state still valid? Has knowledge leaked?
dramatic_irony_maintenance.if_leaked: Force transition to synchronized or adjust documentation
